notes: The San Francisco Call's daily Building Contracts list for the whole of 1908: every issue in curiv_indio, curiv_jenner_ver01 and curiv_llano_ver01 (7,636 OCR pages). Located on three shapes: the list's heading, the entry's shape ('with CONTRACTOR - WORK ... line/corner of ...; $AMOUNT'), and - new for 1908, whose OCR loses heading and amount together on some days - a 'with' followed by a dash and a work word, with 8 blocks kept because a heading had a 'with ... -' within 400 characters of it; entries whose 'with' the OCR lost were found in the gaps between segments and read with an anchor on their first words. Read in one pass, by one reader, on the 1909 spec; private owners, estates and trustees are cut from raw and extra (raw starts at 'with', and ends at the entry's own amount - 126 quotes were cut by hand where the amount was garbled, so that no quote carries the next entry's owner), institutional and company owners kept in extra.owner_firm, and a named building in extra.building_name. A contractor's name garbled past repair is kept as printed and printed as 'a builder' on the page. 1908's OCR reads a capital N as X; the lettered streets are read as their present names (A Anza, B Balboa, C Cabrillo, H Lincoln Way, I Irving, J Judah, M Moraga, N Noriega, T Taraval); First avenue is Arguello, Dupont Grant, Point Lobos Geary, Montgomery avenue Columbus, Army Cesar Chavez, Union Square avenue Maiden Lane, Ridley Duboce, Howard south of Thirteenth South Van Ness (its measurements survive, its numbers do not). Placed with corner.py --batch --json, a lot pass and an offset pass: a single parcel matching the record's lot within 4% (and its offset within 4 ft where one is printed) or its offset within 4 ft (and its lot area within 10% where one is printed), the roll year within two years of 1908 - an alteration a building standing by 1907, through built_by - the side or quadrant the record names, a storey count not off by 1.5 or more, and a corner with neither lot nor offset only on the one corner lot within 90 ft of the crossing. Named buildings placed by hand by name: the Palace Hotel, Phelan, Metropolitan Life, Hibernia Bank, White House, Hewes, YMCA and Elks buildings, the La Granada and Fairmont hotels, the Bank of California, the Columbia Theater, the Cliff House, Old St. Mary's, and the French, St. Mary's, Mary's Help, Children's and Southern Pacific hospitals (the last's power house on its own page); lot 3, Presidio Terrace on the tract-lot key. Only 33 entries print a street number; 31 are refused by the renumbering guard. One parcel is one page, and one entry per building: the general contract, else the earliest, carries the page's entry.

coverage.remaining: Nothing of the 1908 daily lists is known to remain unread: all issues the three batches hold were scanned, 403 page-blocks on 299 days located and read whole, and the gaps between their segments scanned for entries that lost their 'with'. Days without a block are Sundays and holidays the list did not run, and days whose OCR lost the heading and every entry shape; those were not hand-searched. Of the 1,676 unresolved, 550 have no parcel matching the lot or offset with a roll year near 1908 (the building replaced, or the lot re-cut), 485 single candidates were refused (side, roll year, storeys, offset, not the corner lot), 63 match several parcels, 116 are on streets EAS no longer joins or a direction the street does not run, 423 could not be measured (no cross street, no quadrant, an illegible offset or direction, a named building no page carries), 31 print a number the renumbering guard refuses or EAS does not know, and 8 sit on condominium parcels or a parcel with no plain address.
coverage.note: 7,636 OCR pages scanned (every page of 1908 in curiv_indio, curiv_jenner_ver01 and curiv_llano_ver01); 403 page-blocks kept of 721 located; 2,345 candidate segments read, 296 of them not entries (deeds, ads, mining claims, repeated headings), 2,209 contract entries read, 5 of them reprints collapsed - 2,204 findings (2,071 building contracts, 133 alterations). 528 resolved by hand - 437 by corner, offset and lot with corner.py's geometry, 91 on a building the record names - and 1,676 unresolved, each with its reason. 392 published on 392 pages, 239 of them seeded; 136 declined, 134 further contracts for a building whose entry already carries one and 2 contradicting a 1909 contract already on the page.
